payload.description_html: Size comparison of the shuvosaurid Sillosuchus compared to a 1.8 m tall man. The holotype PVSJ 85 is estimated to 3 m (9.8 ft) long, however, the specimen PVL 2267 (isolated vertebra) suggests that it could grow much larger; with an estimated size of 10 m (33 ft).[1]
